title: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster for Nintendo Switch 2 Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
summary: Suikoden I&II HD Remaster brings KONAMI's two classic RPGs to Switch 2 in one package, released on June 5, 2025, at $49.99. The Switch 2 version runs at 1440p on the TV and 1080p in handheld mode, both at 60 FPS. At 10.9 GB for two full RPGs, it is a light install that will not strain the 256 GB internal storage. The physical edition is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge unlocks the download rather than holding the games; you need an internet connection the first time. Spanish is one of its nine languages.
